glossary.angioedema: angioedema (deep swelling under the skin, often around eyes or lips)
glossary.edema: edema (swelling caused by fluid trapped in body tissues)
glossary.jaundice: jaundice (yellowing of the skin or eyes, often linked to the liver)
glossary.vertigo: vertigo (dizziness where the room feels like it is spinning)
glossary.contraindication: contraindication (a medical reason why you should not take a drug)
glossary.overdose: overdose (taking more medicine than is safe)
